<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Agents and pij need quick, general facts about any agent session without knowing that harness's file format. Add `unisphere sessions status` and a matching SDK operation. Input is a pij id, a tmux pane id, or a native session id + harness (several targets per call). Output is one harness-neutral `SessionStatus` shape: current model, context used / window / percent, created, last updated and idle time, last call tokens and cache state, turn counts, compaction count and last compaction. Every fact says where it came from (native, derived, table) or is unknown. It is a single streaming pass over the live transcript built on Plan 028's session-facts fold, so it works on large, growing sessions where the query stack hits limits.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Check any agent session by pij id, tmux pane or session id and get the same facts shape regardless of harness.
- Facts are correct for the questions people actually ask: current model (not the first one), context x of y, idle time, compactions, turns.
- Fast enough to call casually: about a second for a 200 MB live session, and pane lookup in a blink.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Account-level plan usage (5h/weekly %) and cost/pricing: pij owns those.
- Reading Plan 028 prepped tables as a second source (deferred; live fold only).
- Changing the existing query stack, or forking the Plan 028 fold (missing fold facts are requested via the prime).
- Daemons, watchers, writes to native stores or pij, content output.
- Push, PR or merge without the operator.

| ac-0001 | Lookup: `unisphere sessions status` accepts `--pij ID`, `--pane %N`, or `--session ID --harness H`, repeatable in one call. <a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Query stack `sessions show --pij` fails UNI-QUERY-LIMIT on live seats (measured 3/3, 5-6 s each, 2026-09-29). Plan 028 fold already yields per-call model/usage with 1h/5m split, typed compaction boundaries, turn triggers and limit events (Claude only today). pij list --json maps pane->seat->session in 0.24 s (duplicate pane rows exist; liveness required). Claude writes ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json with sessionId and tmux pane; pane_pid is the shell, harness is a child. Claude transcripts record per-call model and a `/model` command record.

<a id="risks-assumptions"></a>

## Risks & Assumptions

Depends on Plan 028 landing first (029 rebases on it). Facts missing from the 028 fold (stop_reason, /model command record, post-compaction tokens) are requested via the prime to 028 PM pij-native-tick; until then they are unknown. Pane ids are reused by tmux, so every pane answer is liveness-checked. OMP/Codex phase waits on 028 phase 2 folds.

<a id="implementation-summary"></a>

## Implementation Summary

Operator rulings after composition (2026-09-30, Jordan via pij-far-jackal): (1) ac-0001 pane budget accepted as about 50 ms, bounded by one ps call (measured native median 28-54 ms, ps alone ~44 ms); vd-0008 now fails only above 75 ms median. (2) Branch push approved and done at 0d48d80 for Pij Plan 157. (3) Scope addition: session status must build and work on macOS, Linux and Windows; pane lookup returns a clean unsupported-platform failure where tmux/ps do not exist; proven by ubuntu container/CI and windows-latest CI.
